status: SOURCE_FIRST_LEARNING_PRESENTATION; exercise adoption is verified per activity, not implied by this map
based_on: BioPython Studio 156-semantic-competency v3; no new competencies or IDs
path_policy: One continuous path, all 156 competencies unlocked. Python 36 foundational skills; Witz-led microscopy 91 skills; NGS 17; ML 12. Prerequisites recommend order but never restrict access.
source_policy: Witz notebooks and the 7 associated exercise sets are primary for beginner image analysis. Source references identify source cells, not claims of completed direct exercise adoption. Secondary references fill debugging, statistics, calibrated microscopy, NGS, ML, scientific software practice. Licensed material requires attribution; real HPA images require asset-specific attribution and provenance. No invented calibrated measurements.

missions.title: Run your first scientific program
missions.goal: Print a biological measurement and inspect Python values.
missions.deliverable: Write a short, readable script that prints a sample ID and measured value.
missions.independent_transfer: Recreate the output for a different sample without hardcoding the original.
missions.teaching_sequence: Learn the skill in the original context → Apply it to the mission → Prove it on unseen inputs
